name: get_object_animation_frame

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetObjectAnimationFrame resolves the top object ID with func_001EAB00 and replaces it with the integer-converted value of object offset 0x16C multiplied by 0.5

notes: Object offset 0x168 stores the animation ID, while func_00130578 initializes the adjacent float at 0x16C from its starting-frame argument and the animation update path advances that field toward the duration at 0x280. A missing object leaves the input value unchanged. All 136 JP calls pass direct object IDs 2 through 9; 128 immediately store the result, and 63 occur directly after wait_ticks(1) in animation-frame polling loops.
